_comment: Delta Force (三角洲行动) playable instrument - DEFAULT GUESS, needs in-game calibration.
Base row: Z X C V B N M ,  ->  do re mi fa sol la si do(upper octave)
Absolute pitches of the base row and the semitone values of the modifiers
are NOT assumptions baked into code - they live here so you can calibrate
Two ways to define the mapping (note_map wins when present for a pitch):
1. note_map: explicit  "<midi number or name>": [modifiers..., key]
last element is the note key, everything before it is a modifier name.
2. auto-generated from base_notes x modifier subsets using each
modifier's 'semitones' offset.  Conflicts resolve to the combination
name: delta_force_default
